fields.Name: T212 - View Record Tags
fields.Description: Opens a record's Tags panel via the toolbar tags control and verifies it renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. In the record toolbar (the row of icons at the TOP-LEFT, just above the Details card), click the Tags control — the TAGS icon (tooltip 'View tags'). Verify a tags panel/area opens for the record — showing existing tags, a clear empty-tags state, or an add-tag input — with no error. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'View tags' (tags icon) control in the record toolbar was clicked
A tags panel/area opened for the record (existing tags, empty state, or add-tag input)
No error messages or crash pages
